sources.observation: Two low round pale-blue towers frame the harbor front above a battered stone seawall. The mansion rises behind the fort with white pilasters, round-headed arches, and an upper balcony.

limitations: Wall and roof heights, the balcony arcade, local harbor-wall batter and small facade details are estimated from the aerial photograph and the sampled grade.
